value: The path rule 'skip an elite under 40 HP' on the mini-run (one turn, 10-29 net @hpb0.01) fails the protocol at n 50 on rows identical to the control: after the mid-act heal only 20 of 996 elite arrivals are under 40 HP (136 on the headline), so its gain is bounded under +1 HP at any n.
